name: Sins Of Omission And Commission
overview: Scripture reveals that sin encompasses both wrongful acts committed and good deeds knowingly neglected, as emphasized in James 4:17 which declares that failing to do what is right is itself sin. The call to repentance is urgent and universal, with God commanding all to turn from ignorance and sin to avoid perishing (Luke 13:3; Acts 17:30). The consequences of sin are severe, leading ultimately to death (James 1:15), and God’s justice is certain, as each person reaps what they sow (Galatians 6:7). Yet salvation is offered by grace through faith, underscoring the necessity of trusting Christ for forgiveness and transformation (Ephesians 2:8).
